title: More Sounds for Ombreval
catalog_status: sound-design candidates; generated draft status is tracked by the local workbench
design_notes: One-shots and sequences are candidates for positional event playback; stable loops are candidates for render-side ambience and should not create NPC inbox events per repetition.
Bell patterns should be assembled from individual stroke assets at runtime, so counted knells and the backward Ruin remain data rather than baked recordings.
Any generated audio containing intelligible words also needs a matching text percept or subtitle for smart actors and accessibility.
The Second Sun, its beams, grave-shadows, countergait, Passing, and fusion remain completely silent. Human reactions, bells, weather, and the building may sound; the phenomenon may not.
Prompts follow the repository's current ElevenLabs workflow and keep modern machinery, electronic effects, and generic fantasy sonics out of Ombreval.
source_basis: Current Bevy geometry, controllers, moving NPC bodies, road carts, lamps, water fixtures, world areas, food/item rounds, and positional sound implementation
Canonical core lore, place gazetteer and routes, wells and water, Dry Boatmen, family/occupation indexes, Second Sun canon, folk culture, calendar, and dedicated city-sound design
